ev_0004.summary: Triangle-like figure with labelled points A, B, C, D, E, F. Drawn lines: A-B (horizontal top), B-E-D (long diagonal through E to D), A-E-C (line through E to C), D-C (bottom horizontal), A-F-D (left side with interior foot F), and F-E (short near-horizontal segment from F to E). All strokes are solid; no dashed strokes. E is the crossing of BD and AC and is the endpoint of FE. No right-angle square marker is visible in the raster, so no angle_marks or right_angle objects. Existing OCR bindings for A, B, C, D, E, F are all correct; no replacements needed.

payload.notes: Coordinates A–F are program-owned and not redefined; all paths and label bindings use those names. Edges AB, BE/ED, AE/EC, DC, AF/FD (F lies on AD, so the left side is drawn through F), and FE are drawn solid, black, with line width 1.3pt and round joins from STYLE METRICS. Labels use the measured 13.5/16.2 pt font and the requested placements. No right-angle marks were verified, so none are drawn. No measurement concerns were found: E lies on both BD and AC, and F lies on AD within rounding. The instruction's pixel-to-unit conversion (x/100) was superseded by the program's frame, as the system prompt requires.

source_construction.summary: Triangle-like figure with labelled points A, B, C, D, E, F. Drawn lines: A-B (horizontal top), B-E-D (long diagonal through E to D), A-E-C (line through E to C), D-C (bottom horizontal), A-F-D (left side with interior foot F), and F-E (short near-horizontal segment from F to E). All strokes are solid; no dashed strokes. E is the crossing of BD and AC and is the endpoint of FE. No right-angle square marker is visible in the raster, so no angle_marks or right_angle objects. Existing OCR bindings for A, B, C, D, E, F are all correct; no replacements needed.
